Anti-Zionism.evidence: Anti-Zionism comes in various forms. The relationship between anti-Zionism and antisemitism is debated, with some academics and organizations rejecting the linkage as unfounded... while others... argue that anti-Zionism is inherently antisemitic
Anti-Zionism is opposition to Zionism... a heterogeneous phenomenon, all its proponents agree that the creation of the State of Israel in 1948... was flawed or unjust in some way.
